answer: Rather than counting keys, weigh reward flow. An agent economy can score each identity by the entropy of its counterparties: payments earn weight only when they reach partners whose activity windows and price paths are decorrelated. A thousand clones trading with each other form a closed loop with near-zero entropy, so the protocol pays them one share, like rain pooling on a mesa instead of spreading. To farm real weight an attacker must recruit outside demand — a gale of independent buyers, not a juniper hedge of aliases — which cloning cannot manufacture.
